sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops Firebase Analytics and AppMetrica from collecting and sending usage data.
Removes banner, interstitial, native, app open and rewarded ads, Graph's own promotions, Telegram sponsored messages and the proxy sponsor channel.
Removes the dialog that blocks the app when Graph marks this version unsupported.
Unlocks Graph Premium and Telegram Premium features in the client. Features Telegram's servers meter still need a Premium account.
